paths.title: Custody & Parenting Time
paths.summary: Educational resources for parents trying to understand initial custody decisions, parenting time, modification, and related court preparation.
questions: Is there already a written custody or parenting-time order?
Is this an initial case or a request to modify an existing order?
What does the current order actually say?
Has anything materially changed since the current order?
Are there interstate, military, incarceration, domestic-violence, or child-safety issues?
authorityLayers: Verified published Alabama appellate authority matched to the specific issue

paths.title: Child Support
paths.summary: Educational resources covering Alabama child-support guidelines, existing orders, modification, enforcement, income records, and shared-custody issues.
questions: Is there already a child-support order?
Is the issue establishment, modification, enforcement, arrears, or income verification?
What custody or parenting-time arrangement exists?
What income records are available?
Are child-care or health-insurance costs part of the issue?
authorityLayers: Applicable Alabama statutes and court rules
Verified published Alabama appellate authority matched to the legal proposition

paths.title: DHR & Agency Processes
paths.summary: Educational navigation for Alabama DHR child-support and family-resource processes.
questions: What program, notice, or agency action is involved?
Is there a connected court case?
Does the notice state a deadline or hearing date?
Are there safety concerns that require a different resource path?
authorityLayers: Verified Alabama case authority when interpretation is needed

paths.title: Court Preparation
paths.summary: Educational checklists for organizing documents, questions, timelines, and official resources before a hearing.
questions: What court and case type are involved?
What issue is the hearing expected to address?
What orders already exist?
What documents, communications, receipts, calendars, and records are available?
authorityLayers: Relevant statutes and verified appellate authority for the issue

paths.title: Family & Public Resources
paths.summary: Navigation to public-benefit, child-care, health, parenting, safety, and family-stability resources.
questions: What county or service area applies?
What kind of help is needed?
Is the need urgent or safety-related?
Are age, household, work, school, or income factors relevant?
